system.name: Pallgerix
system.subtitle: Healthcare platform stack · 5 clinics · staff-only access

components.name: PostgreSQL
bullets: App reads and writes patient records on every request
Nightly backup job dumps to encrypted S3 bucket

components.name: Stripe
bullets: App calls Stripe to charge a card when an invoice is created
Stripe webhook confirms payment status back to the app

components.name: Twilio
bullets: App sends appointment reminder SMS 24h before visit

components.name: Auth0
bullets: Staff authenticate via Auth0 before accessing any clinic data
Auth0 issues a JWT the app validates on every request

components.name: Amazon S3
bullets: App uploads scanned intake forms and lab results
App generates signed URLs for staff to download files
